title: Coronavirus Update 98: Rapid COVID 19 Antigen Testing at Home - A Possible Breakthrough
summary: MedCram's Dr. Roger Seheult summarizes a discussion with Dr. Michael Mina on cheap, paper-based at-home COVID-19 antigen tests. It explains why lower sensitivity can still work well for screening infectious people.
why: Pointed to in 2020 testing threads for a visual explanation of why rapid antigen tests still serve a purpose.

quote.text: Medcram has a good video talking about this.
